messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 — Elevated 5xx rate observed for hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate (us-west1).
- Start: 2024-05-08T16:00:00Z
- Current: 12% 5xx over baseline, error spikes correlate with larger payloads and multi-chunk responses
- Autoscaler: no signs of scale failures; GPU utilization normal

oncall-anna: Acknowledged. Paging PD now. Moving this thread -> war room.
War room: https://redwood.internal/warroom/wnr-7123
PD: PagerDuty incident INC-8421

sre-jamal: I'm in the war room. Initial hypothesis: runtime kernel selection path for long-context requests is hitting a fallback that returns 502. Will pull logs from candidate nodes.
I can repro a sample 502 locally with a 2048-token prompt and batch_size=16.

eng-maya: Reassigning owner to Jamal for mitigation and rollback coordination. I'll stand by for quick patch or model-variant fallback.

pm-ravi: Customer impact: partners+free tier in us-west1. Estimated affected traffic ~8-15% depending on request size. No enterprise-only config flagged so likely broader.
Suggest status page + partner DM; avoid mass email until we confirm scope.

ops-liz: Confirming paging list alerted: oncall, infra-eng, SRE, and platform-ops. Notifying legal/comms after we have a clear impact statement.

sre-jamal: Quick mitigation plan (iterative):
1) Scale down batch_size on serving pools handling long-context to reduce kernel path complexity (safe config change)
2) Route long-context requests to model-variant 'gpt-lite-3.7b-q' which has been validated for robustness
3) If above doesn't reduce 5xx within 2 mins, deploy automatic fallback to regional-compatible replica (us-east1)

oncall-anna: Executing step 1 now: updating pool config and restarting 3 worker groups (rolling). Command:
```
redwoodctl pool update serving-pool-west --batch-size 8 --rolling-restart
```

sre-jamal: Logs: attaching few excerpts (snippets):
```
2024-05-08T16:02:12Z [worker-17] ERROR kv_cache: missing-kv-entry -> returning 502
2024-05-08T16:02:13Z [worker-17] WARN kernel-select: fallback-to-generic-kernel
```
Those lines line up with the failure window.

eng-maya: If rollback needed, what are the steps? quick checklist?
sre-jamal: Rollback = revert to previous serving-runtime image (v2.14.1) via canary then promote. Command:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback serving-runtime --to v2.14.1 --canary 10%
```

statuspage-bot: DRAFT status page entry:
```
Title: Degraded responses for /v1/generate in US-West (Investigating)
Impact: Some requests to the hosted Generate API are returning 5xx errors, primarily for larger prompts and multi-chunk responses. A subset of users in us-west1 may experience failed requests or retries.
Status: Investigating
Started: 2024-05-08T16:00:00Z
Next update: in 15 minutes or sooner
Mitigation: Engineering is rolling config changes and routing adjustments to reduce 5xx rates.
```

pm-ravi: Approve posting that draft (keep generic, no SLA language). I'll prepare partner DM template if impact persists.

ops-liz: Notifying Customer Success to prepare inbound DM list for top 20 partners.

oncall-anna: Pool update rolled, 3 worker groups restarted. Monitoring metrics.

sre-jamal: Early signal: 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 5% after batch_size change. Continuing with routing to model-variant.

eng-maya: Preparing model-variant routing rule change now. Command will be run with 5% canary:
```
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate --filter "context_len>1024" --model gpt-lite-3.7b-q --canary 5%
```

sre-jamal: Canary applied. Observing logs and metrics.

statuspage-bot: Posting update to status page now with the draft above.

pm-ravi: Draft customer DM (for CS to edit):
"We are investigating elevated error rates on the hosted Generate API affecting some requests in US-West. Engineering is actively mitigating and we will follow up within 30 minutes with updates. If you are seeing repeated failures please reply with request IDs and sample payload sizes."

ops-liz: CS notified. Partner list export queued: https://redwood.internal/cs/partner_exports/8421

sre-jamal: Canary shows 5xx down to 1.2% on canary replica. Gradually promoting routing change to 50% then 100% if stable.

oncall-anna: Noting handoff plan: I'll keep this active until 17:00Z, then handoff to Night SRE (sre-kim) at 17:05Z. Handoff checklist: current mitigations, PD status, status page link, war room link.

eng-maya: Thanks team. Keep updates short here. If anything needs customer-visible changes, PM and ops will coordinate.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8421 severity set to P1. Links: War room: https://redwood.internal/warroom/wnr-7123 | Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/8421

sre-jamal: Final note before handoff: root cause looks tied to kernel-selection when KV cache misses coincide with large context batches. We'll open a follow-up postmortem and a remediation ticket to add safer fallback and better observability for kernel selection paths.

oncall-anna: OK handing off in 5m to sre-kim. War room will remain open. If anyone else is stepping out, ping here before leaving.

sre-jamal: Leaving war room, monitoring alerts set. Good job team.

end of thread
